topics.title: Road Transport and National Highways
topics.ncert_sections: Land Transport, Road Transport, National Highways, National Highways Development Projects

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the size, history and classification of India's road network and the share of traffic it carries.
Explain the role of National Highways and the National Highways Authority of India.
Identify the Golden Quadrilateral, North-South and East-West Corridors and Bharatmala Pariyojana and their purposes.

topics.title: State, District, Rural and Other Roads
topics.ncert_sections: State Highways, District Roads, Rural Roads, Other Roads

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish State Highways, District Roads and Rural Roads and explain regional variation in rural road density.
Explain the work of the Border Roads Organisation and the purpose of international highways.
Recall the beginning of Indian Railways and explain why the system is divided into zones.
Distinguish broad, metre and narrow gauges by track width and length.
Analyse the development and regional distribution of railways, including the Konkan Railway and metro rail.

topics.title: Water Transport
topics.ncert_sections: Water Transport, Inland Waterways, National Waterways, Oceanic Routes

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the features of inland water transport and the reasons for its decline.
Identify India's National Waterways and the authority that develops them.
Evaluate the importance of oceanic routes for India's foreign trade.

topics.title: Air Transport and Oil and Gas Pipelines
topics.ncert_sections: Air Transportation, Oil and Gas Pipelines

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the development of air transport in India, including UDAN and Pawan Hans.
Describe the advantages of pipelines and India's major oil and gas pipeline networks.

topics.title: Communication Networks
topics.ncert_sections: Communication Networks, Personal Communication System, Mass Communication System, Satellite Communication

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the internet is the most effective personal communication system.
Trace the development of radio and television as mass communication in India.
Distinguish the INSAT and IRS satellite systems and their uses.
